title: VUA packages-repos result v0.1
description: Result documents for the packages-repos v0.1 read face (proposal 025 P2 freeze batch 2026-09-17). The envelope mirrors the standing wire shape (schemaVersion/operation/result): the envelope const is the word-list-row family version 0.1; the result document carries its own family const vua.packages-repos/v0.1 — two independent versions (the c914cf2 standing rule). Each repo row is the frozen projection of ONE subscription entry: the four identifier/location facts are nullable strings — null is the honest projection of the library's Option (a local-directory repo has url=null; a remote repo may lack name or id) — and cached is the REQUIRED per-repo cache-hit fact: true = a refreshed local cache exists for this subscription, false = subscribed but never refreshed (its own honest state; the consumer must render it as such, never as an empty catalog). There is deliberately NO health field: the library carries no health fact carrier (VrcGetMeta is etag-only) and the converged ruling listed the health face as a P2 non-goal — a row carrying health/status/lastRefreshed is INVALID by schema, not merely discouraged (false-assertion guard, P1 additionalProperties discipline). Row order is the subscription face's own order (the settings userRepos array order — the user's configuration fact projected verbatim); the consumer relies on it as presentation fact and never re-sorts. An EMPTY repos array is a valid, honest answer (zero subscriptions).

repoId.description: Subscription identifier; null when the library carries none.

name.description: Subscription display name; null when the library carries none.

url.description: Remote repository URL; null for a local-directory repo (the location then lives in localPath).

localPath.description: Local cache file path of the subscription; null when the library carries none.

cached.description: Per-repo cache-hit fact: true = a refreshed local cache exists; false = subscribed but never refreshed (honest listed state, never hidden).
